value.publicReason: The capability-delivery repair is confirmed: the prior arrival inquiry was never executed for lack of current interface navigation, not because the method failed. The current descriptor (2202) exposes firstRoundInitialization, native_action, inspect and legal_full_path_movement, and the delivered successor receipt (2098) shows marine-1's actionCapabilityReference routes include deploy (index 16) and move (index 17) in the movement phase — a real, method-different path that the exhausted single-relocation chain (2091/2092, card player1-tactical-1 exhausted, provenArrivalHistory=false) never used. I therefore authorize ONE bounded, method-different arrival inquiry on question 1: fresh first-round initialization plus a Native deploy/move chain for marine-1 toward (12,24), reusing the saved successful deploy state rather than the exhausted relocation card. This is not a repeat: the method changes from a single relocation step to first-round initialization plus deploy/move domains, and the prerequisite changes because the current capability descriptor now exposes those operations. Question 2 (marker-control range) remains a necessary Rules-authority fact that no local experiment can supply; it is not dispatched. Question 3 (Medic core vs goliath-1 anti-armour substitution) remains an open author decision: the measured single-attack comparison (862/866) is scoped to the small/Kinetic-Foam-only configuration and does not prove combined volleys, survival, arrival timing or overall army superiority, so I retain the current army and keep the choice pending. Question 4 is decided here: authorize the bounded arrival experiment rather than declare the activation order and round-2 VP target without the fact. The current Plan already sets scheduleStatus=unknown with an empty targetVpSchedule (r23 revision, 2208), so no Plan mutation is needed now; the army stays legal at 2000/2000 with 0 unspent (2209).
